ev.q: A zombie apocalypse has killed billions and shattered world civilization
the group moves through buildings searching for supplies and fighting zombies
A character's morale must also be managed
text-based events, where the player must choose a response to problems
which can be spent on permanent upgrades for future journeys
they must survive a growing zombie horde for a set amount of time
There they are met by Mounties and a Justin Trudeau-lookalike
disliking the repetitiveness of the game
The brutal, random nature too often made me feel like I had little agency in my quest
